title: Vercel UI SDK: Tri-Modal UI Verification — WAI-ARIA APG Key Checks, Clock/DOM-Isolated SSR & Mirrored RTL Parity
summary: @ui-sdk/core/testing enforces three orthogonal deterministic contracts on every primitive: checkPattern aggregates all WAI-ARIA APG role, reference, and keyboard navigation defects across 15 patterns into a single error; checkServer isolates globals (document, window, navigator, localStorage, sessionStorage, matchMedia) and throws on Date.now, new Date(), performance.now, Math.random, and crypto randomness; checkDirection verifies ArrowRight in LTR matches ArrowLeft in RTL on focus and mirrored direction/side state.

references.description: checkPattern supporting 15 WAI-ARIA APG patterns and collecting all violations into one unified report
isolated() SSR safety harness blocking DOM globals, clocks (Date.now/new Date/performance.now), and randomness
checkDirection asserting mirrored LTR ArrowRight and RTL ArrowLeft focus targets and direction/side state

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Headless UI primitives require tri-modal automated verification: exhaustive APG pattern checks (15 patterns), strict SSR clock/DOM/entropy isolation, and mirrored LTR-vs-RTL keyboard state parity.
